title: Test a narrow effect-integrity interchange across Runner, WIP, and DriftGuard
claim: The V0 effect envelope has demonstrated three-producer interoperability and two source-agnostic observers, but measured maintenance value remains unproven and a portfolio search found no valid pre-existing downstream source-specific effect parser whose code can currently be removed without invading native authority or a different semantic domain.

consumers.role: current M6 producer of neutral GitHub mutation effect envelopes
operation-journal producer of neutral effect envelopes
behavioral reload decision and downstream acknowledgement tracking without claiming behavioral recovery

preserved_boundaries: Project Runner remains owner of work graph, dispatch, budgets, backend capability, target authority, leases, and completion semantics.
WIP remains owner of workspace recovery cadence, checkpoint history, continuation surfaces, and ambiguous-effect recovery workflow.
A shared contract may define mechanical fields/states but may not make either repository authoritative over the other.

DriftGuard remains owner of drift evidence admission, reload decisions, acknowledgement acceptance, restore-anchor advancement, and behavioral-recovery claim ceilings; a caller acknowledgement may not be normalized into verified recovery.

WIP operation-event schema blob 66f9b5103e9ecc114feb9cb8fa6cebdc34082c2d defines PREPARED, ATTEMPTED, VERIFIED, FAILED, AMBIGUOUS, and RECONCILED with expected precondition and effect receipt.
WIP HEAD schema blob 7f94e4ea2358926fb3f2bf248cd3cb7600e246cd provides generation concurrency independently of Runner lease fencing.

Discovery observer blob 67dd00cc1c96120151ffa4eb38dc9d3893802ada derives the V0 contract from the schema and contains no current producer-specific parser branches.

rejection_conditions: The proposed common contract requires Project Runner-specific scheduling semantics.
The proposed common contract requires WIP-specific workspace/checkpoint lifecycle semantics.
Adapters needed to share the contract exceed the duplicated implementation removed.
A common state vocabulary creates ambiguity between execution completion and recovery reconciliation.
Either project loses a viable standalone path.
Supporting DriftGuard requires mapping an accepted reload acknowledgement to POST_EFFECT_VERIFIED or otherwise claiming behavioral recovery not established by the native source.
The neutral envelope becomes an input to DriftGuard decision, acknowledgement, retry, or restore-anchor logic.
A third consumer can serialize into the envelope but no duplicated translation, recovery, or custody implementation is actually removed.

critical_objections: The broad shared execution/recovery/control state-machine hypothesis remains rejected.
Two observers demonstrate source-agnostic parsing, but actual pre-existing parser LOC removed remains zero.
The search for a real existing parser replacement target found only native authority paths or different semantic domains such as provider currentness/projection reconciliation.
Replacing Project Runner recovery or BT2 BugOps native state with V0 would improperly promote an interchange vocabulary into execution/retry/closure authority.
Further centralization has no current evidence basis; the experiment should remain dormant until an organic downstream parser can be measurably replaced.

notes: Three exact producer branches have hosted PASS at their bounded adapter scopes.
Two independent source-agnostic observers have been demonstrated; the second remains source-pass / hosted-not-executed.
Measured burden remains 1,095 core physical lines + 804 test lines, with zero actual pre-existing parser LOC deleted.
Candidate remains EXPERIMENTING; PROVEN_REUSABLE and shared-runtime-library promotion remain unjustified.
